sample_unit: discharge summaries with ground-truth reference discharge instructions
unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning an open-source LLM with detailed, task-specific instructions rather than generic instructions to improve discharge instruction generation quality

screen.reason: The study tests different fine-tuning instruction strategies (detailed vs generic) on a model's automated NLP metrics when generating discharge instructions. Comparing model fine-tuning paradigms is model development rather than an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
